stance_rationale: Time-series alpha dimension (RF-A7) is present, but mandatory alpha robustness gates remain unmet: subperiod stability and DSR both fail, and the reported Harvey statistic is not HAC/Newey-West validated. AX-007 exception proof is also not established for the current single-sleeve top-20 style construction.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is multi-date and monthly-consistent; however, weights.csv is single-sig_date only, so walk-forward weight schedule evidence is still required to fully rule out static application in downstream execution.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: run_alpha_research.R uses Factor_Name -> Z_Score_Aligned path via load_month_factors(); no NEGATE_FACTORS/FLIP_SIGN usage found.
C14 is asserted through load_month_factors()/Factor DB connector usage; no explicit violation artifact observed in provided files.
Signal build loop calls load_month_factors(sig_date, coverage_min=0.05); direct monthly parquet factor loading not used in alpha script.
Overlay path explicitly uses lagged BM inputs: dd_20d_lag/vol_60d_lag/shift(.,1L).
No per-factor release-lag audit table (annual->May, quarterly->45d) is emitted; only narrative assertion is provided.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory robustness gates are failed (subperiod_stability=0.345 < 0.50; DSR=0.0592 < 0.50). This prevents alpha graduation confidence even with strong point estimates.
Reported Harvey statistic is computed as simple IC t-stat (mean/sd/sqrt(n)) without Newey-West HAC treatment, so RF-A6 multi-testing defense is incomplete.

Overlay is a BM-shared scalar per date (single overlay_mult each date; score_z vs score_eff rank-correlation=1 across all dates), so cross-sectional alpha mechanism is unchanged and IC equality is by construction.

AX-007 exception proof is missing: package remains single-sleeve long-only top-20/18 style without explicit evidence for allowed exception routes (multi-sleeve, long-short, 50+ diversification, ML sizing exception criteria).
PIT C4 is not artifact-verifiable from outputs; fundamental lag discipline is asserted but not demonstrated with factor-level usable-date audit evidence.
weights.csv contains one sig_date (2024-01-22) only. While alpha_scores is time-series, downstream walk-forward weight scheduling proof is needed to fully eliminate Iter-4-style static schedule risk.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet passes core RF-A7 structure checks: Date x Ticker x score fields with 252 sig_dates (2003-02-28 to 2024-01-22), no future dates.
Covariance artifact is PSD with condition number approximately 11.058 (<=100 post-shrink expectation) when reconstructed from ticker_i/ticker_j triangular storage.
No banned rationalization phrases from the base-context auto-flag list were detected in reviewed package/challenge artifacts.
unresolved_disputes: Requested stage artifact path `stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_006` is missing; `stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_006` exists but is empty, so duplicate-location cross-check cannot be completed.
Need explicit HAC/Newey-West t_NW and 5-spec regression bundle (CAPM/Carhart3/Carhart4/FF5/FF6) for RF-A6 closure.
Need factor-level C4 audit output proving annual May / quarterly 45-day lag enforcement at usable-date granularity.
Need explicit walk-forward weight schedule artifact to verify no static weight reuse in execution/backtest pipeline.
weakest_assumption: That a portfolio-level BM scalar overlay can be treated as an alpha enhancement despite leaving cross-sectional ranking unchanged and therefore not improving the alpha mechanism itself.
rebuttal_required: Recompute and report Harvey-Liu-Zhu gate with Newey-West HAC t-stat (t_NW) and provide full multi-spec regression evidence.
Provide a concrete stabilization plan that raises subperiod_stability from 0.345 to >=0.50 without violating PIT.
Demonstrate AX-007 exception compliance (or redesign out of single-sleeve top-20 mechanism).
Publish factor-level C4 lag audit table (usable_date vs sig_date) for all fundamental-linked factors.
Provide walk-forward weights schedule (multi-sig_date) used by Forge/execution to close RF-A7 residual risk.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Cross-model audit confirms the time-series alpha artifact exists, but robustness/statistical validation and AX-007 mechanism compliance are not yet sufficient for PASS-level triangulation.

alpha_specific_questions: Harvey gate를 Newey-West HAC(t_NW) 기준으로 다시 계산하면 여전히 2.95 이상을 유지하는가?
overlay가 BM-shared scalar인 현재 설계에서 AX-007 예외를 어떤 근거로 충족한다고 주장할 수 있는가?
weights 시계열 스케줄을 Forge가 실제로 어떻게 소비했는지(단일 snapshot 미사용)를 어떤 아티팩트로 증명할 수 있는가?
